intro: Designed for impact, built for connection. The Leon dining table makes a bold impression with its glass-in-wood design and seats eight in sleek, comfortable style.

features.title: Bold glass elegance
features.text: A black-tinted glass top adds a modern edge and smooth finish that elevates your dining space instantly.

features.title: Built to support
features.text: With a rubberwood understructure, your table stays grounded and reliable—beautifully strong beneath the surface.

features.title: Soft, rounded edges
features.text: Curved edges lend a subtle sophistication and comfort, making every corner safe and inviting.

features.title: Assemble with ease
features.text: Thanks to knockdown construction, your table is easy to set up and fits perfectly into your home, hassle-free.

features.title: A frame like no other
features.text: The unique glass-in-wood design isn’t just elegant—it’s distinctive, making your table a true conversation starter.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Leon 8-Seater Tinted Glass Rectangular Dining Table
